name: Parameter range values
purpose: The prv table lists the allowed values and value ranges of each range set declared in PRF, one record per allowed range or discrete value. A record with both a minimum and a maximum defines an inclusive range: a parameter value passes the check if it lies within the limits or equals one of them. A record with only a minimum and an empty maximum defines one allowed discrete value. A set can mix any number of ranges and discrete values, one record per allowed value or range, so that the records of a set together list everything the parameter may take. The limits are written in the representation and type declared by the set (PRF_INTER, PRF_DSPFMT) and, for unsigned integers, in its radix (PRF_RADIX); their maximum length follows from the maximum command size. SCOS-2000 applies these checks when command parameters and sequence formal parameters are entered or loaded, for example on a manual stack; by default only formal parameter values are checked when a sequence is loaded.

fields.name: PRV_NUMBR
fields.description: Name (PRF_NUMBR) of the range set to which this allowed value or range belongs.

fields.name: PRV_MINVAL
fields.description: Low limit of the range, or the single allowed value if PRV_MAXVAL is empty. Written in a format compatible with PRF_DSPFMT (and PRF_RADIX for unsigned integers). Part of the key. Maximum length depends on the maximum command size.

fields.name: PRV_MAXVAL
fields.description: High limit of the range. Empty means that PRV_MINVAL is a discrete allowed value. Written in a format compatible with PRF_DSPFMT (and PRF_RADIX for unsigned integers).

relationships.note: Range set owning the value/range; representation and radix come from PRF.

history: ICD 5.1 (2001, section 3.3.3.7.2, PDF p.103-104): PRV_NUMBR Number(4), PRV_MINVAL and PRV_MAXVAL Char(17), key PRV_NUMBR + PRV_MINVAL. ICD 6.7 Draft A (PDF p.199) and ICD 6.9 (PDF p.204): PRV_NUMBR Char(10). ICD 7.0 (PDF p.213): limit fields without fixed size, bounded by the maximum command size (S2K-8073, PDF p.261). pyscos2000 (ICD 7.2) has the same three columns, the same key and PRV_MAXVAL optional.
notes: No discrepancy in columns, keys or optionality (3 columns in prv.dat). Solar Orbiter 2025-09-16: 1072 records (631 in 2020) for 565 sets, all resolving to PRF. 762 records are ranges and 310 are discrete values; all 310 discrete values belong to the 16 ASCII (engineering text) range sets, so every numeric set is expressed as min/max ranges. Hexadecimal limits are written without prefix (e.g. 0 to 7FFF for set VIP06012). Longest limits: 16 characters (PRV_MINVAL), 10 (PRV_MAXVAL).
